Economy · India

India plans strategic fuel reserves amid geopolitical concerns

India is planning to build strategic reserves of fuel, including LPG, LNG, and crude oil, to enhance energy security. This initiative comes in response to geopolitical shocks, particularly the crisis in West Asia, which has impacted oil prices and supply chains. The move aims to reduce reliance on Middle Eastern oil and ensure a stable energy supply for the country.
